title: Which film?
instructions: İki arkadaş hangi filmi izleyeceklerini seçiyor. Film türü ve saate dikkat et.

script.speaker: jo
script.text: Let's go to the cinema tonight. There are two new films.

script.speaker: jo
script.text: One is a comedy, and one is a horror film.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: I don't like horror films. They're scary!

script.speaker: jo
script.text: OK, the comedy. It starts at seven or at nine.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: Seven is better. I'm tired, and I want to sleep early.

script.speaker: jo
script.text: Great. Let's meet at the cinema at quarter to seven.

questions.prompt: What kind of films are there?
options: a comedy and a horror film
a love film and a comedy
an action film and a comedy
questions.feedback: Bir komedi ve bir korku filmi var.
questions.evidence: One is a comedy, and one is a horror film.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Ali want the horror film?
What time does their film start?
questions.feedback: Yorgun olduğu için saat yedideki seansı seçiyorlar.

questions.prompt: What time are they going to meet?
questions.evidence: Let's meet at the cinema at quarter to seven.
